crossing_on_horseback.text: You ride through the valley at full speed. Eden pushes his horse relentlessly. Behind you, Regalus—the bandit leader who nearly killed you—sleeps soundly despite the violent motion. After several hours on horseback, you reach Kelia’s Crossing, a fortified elven city. Two elven legionaries guard the gate—playing cards until they notice Eden approaching.

elf_and_eden_talk.text: "Halt!" a legionary commands. "No one enters without a pass—orders of the Dumvir." Eden smirks. "Here is my pass." He gestures toward Regalus tied to the horse. "Regalus!" the legionary exclaims. "Enter. The Dumvir will want to reward you personally." The gates open.

walking_city_human.text: The streets teem with life. You decide to cut through the main square, the heart of the city, taken over today by a sprawling market. Merchants and locals crowd around the stalls, haggling over all kinds of goods. The sheer mass of people creates a deafening cacophony. You quickly become the center of attention—maybe because you, Eden and Regalus are the only humans in this elven city.

walking_city.text: The streets are crowded. You cross the main square, overtaken today by a massive market. Merchants and townsfolk swarm the stalls, bargaining loudly in a chaotic roar. You draw a lot of attention—likely because Eden and the criminal tied to the horse are the only humans in this elven city.

talking_to_dumvir.text: Inside the Curia, the Dumvir stops mid-discussion at the sight of Regalus. "Regalus! Finally caught!" A purse of gold is handed to Eden. The Dumvir then turns toward both of you. "To whom do I owe this reward?" Eden introduces himself, then looks at you.

introduction_answer.text: "Delighted!" says the Dumvir, acknowledging both you and Eden. Legionaries move Regalus toward a cell. The Dumvir sighs. "Although... a criminal like Regalus means a long and tedious trial. I do not have time for such matters—especially now." He turns to both of you. "As hunters, you are legally permitted to end his life. It would spare us the trial entirely." Eden scratches his chin, intrigued.

shy_introduction_answer.text: "Not very talkative, I see," the Dumvir notes. Legionaries drag Regalus toward a cell. "Although... dealing with this criminal means a long, exhausting trial I cannot afford right now." He turns to you and Eden alike. "As hunters, you are permitted by law to execute him on the spot. It would spare us the entire trial." Eden seems interested.

deciding_regalus_fate.text: "Double the bounty and it's a deal," Eden says. "Impossible," replies the Dumvir. He looks at both of you. "Perhaps your companion would accept to eliminate Regalus? It would rid Li’ark of a dangerous criminal once and for all."

killing_regalus.text: You accept. The Dumvir hands you his blade. One swift motion ends Regalus’s life. Blood floods the floor until legionaries remove the body. The Dumvir exhales. "Thank you. You and your fellow hunter have done this city a great service."

choices.text: Say it was a pleasure killing parasites like him.
Say it was necessary, though unpleasant.

pleasure_killing_answer.text: "I wouldn’t go that far, but I see your point." The Dumvir pauses—an idea forming. "How would you and your companion feel about another task—one worth four times this bounty?" Eden’s eyes gleam.

necessary_kill_answer.text: "We share the same conviction," the Dumvir replies. "Now… how would you and your partner feel about another task—worth four times the bounty?" Eden brightens.

sparing_regalus.text: You refuse. The Dumvir, disappointed but understanding, orders legionaries to take Regalus to his cell. "I cannot blame you. It takes true courage to do what must be done—not everyone possesses it."

choices.text: Say you do not kill without reason.
Say that Regalus still deserves a fair trial.

killing_without_reason_answer.text: "Admirable. But…" The Dumvir pauses—an idea forming. "What would you and your companion say to another task—worth four times this bounty?" Eden is visibly thrilled.

deserves_trial_answer.text: "Regalus will hang eventually, trial or no trial…" The Dumvir stops—an idea forming. "What would you and your fellow hunter say to another task—worth four times the bounty?"

keep_silent_answer.text: The Dumvir studies you for a moment, then smiles faintly. "Perhaps silence is wisdom. Now—what would you and your partner say to a task worth four times this bounty?" Eden nearly vibrates with excitement.

discussing_undead.text: In his office, the Dumvir explains: "A dark plague haunts our region… undead emerge each night from beneath the Globe. We tried to hold them back, but arrows run out—and they do not stop coming. So we sealed the gates." He gazes out the window at the city.

dumvir_talks_necromancer.text: "One of my scouts died to bring us this information." He spreads a map, stabbing his dagger into a marked location. "The Crypt of the Ancients. Forbidden magic is at work there—surely a necromancer. My legionaries failed repeatedly. I need a new approach. That is where you and your companion come in."

dumvir_asks_for_help.text: "You must enter the Crypt, slip past the undead, reach the necromancer in the depths, and kill him. Do this, and you will earn 10,000 gold—each." Eden beams. When he asks about Imperial reinforcements, the Dumvir scoffs: "The Empire is busy fighting Orcs in the South. You two are our only hope. Will you accept?"

choices.text: Correct him: you are not a bounty hunter.

explanation_attempt.text: You open your mouth to correct him, but Eden's hand lands on your shoulder. "20,000 gold each," he says smoothly. "We are dealing with undead and necromancy—not petty bandits." The Dumvir hesitates, then accepts. You both leave the Curia.

letting_eden_talk.text: "20,000 gold each," Eden declares, cutting you off. "Undead, black magic, a necromancer… this is no ordinary mission." After hesitation, the Dumvir agrees. Eden claps his hands joyfully. You leave the Curia together.
